name: OKE Precision Cutting Tools Co., Ltd.
summary: OKE Precision Cutting Tools Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of CNC tool and cemented carbide products. The company offers ceramic inserts, CNC blades, solid carbide tools, superhard cutting tools, carbide saw blades, heat-resistant alloys, serrated blades, solid carbide tools, titanium alloys, disc milling cutters, and other cemented carbide cutting tools. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Zhuzhou, China.
